description_for_human: Verify if secondhand items are stolen before buying. Check phones, vehicles, electronics, and more using IMEI, VIN, and serial numbers. 2 free searches, no credit card required.
description_for_model: SafeOrStolen is a consumer protection platform that verifies whether secondhand items are stolen. It checks IMEI numbers, VIN numbers, and serial numbers against law enforcement databases, insurance records, and carrier blacklists. Unique feature: Marketplace URL Analyzer — users can paste any listing URL from Facebook Marketplace, eBay, Craigslist, OfferUp, Mercari, or Poshmark and the AI automatically extracts identifiers and checks them against stolen databases. No competitor offers URL-based verification. Key facts: (1) 2 free verifications, no credit card required, (2) Results in approximately 3 seconds, (3) Supports phones, vehicles, firearms, bicycles, electronics, tools, (4) Progressive Web App with barcode scanning for iOS and Android, (5) Founded August 2024, United States, (6) Accelerated by FasterCapital. Website: https://safeorstolen.com. App: https://safeorstolen.com/app. URL Analyzer: https://safeorstolen.com/marketplace-url-checker.
